summary: Pins that find's single-pass ripgrep body lane (scanCombinedRg) yields the SAME file → terms table as the old per-term scans: each case runs collectCoverage twice on one fake index, toggling process.env.COLDSTART_FIND_SCAN='perterm' (read at call time, so no module reload). Fixtures are the cases where a shortcut breaks: overlapping terms ('panelogix' hides `logix` under `rg -o` attribution), nesting (Reporter ⊂ Reporters ⊂ ExpressionReporter), rg -i folds ſ/K, UTF-16 LE/BE with BOM (the real bug: terms missing when read as UTF-8) and UTF-8 BOM. The explicit UTF-16 assertions assume a ripgrep is resolvable (true in CI via bundled @vscode/ripgrep); the pure-Node fallback would not decode UTF-16.
